why: Whether an order is the reader's own is the server's judgement, sent as mine: a manager viewing as a participant sees that participant's orders as theirs, which ownerId cannot say -- and ownerId is null on everyone else's order anyway. FMClientLibrary's Order.my_current() and most robots depend on it. A counterparty's private order also names the counterparty in ownerTarget, from the reader's side.
